about: Cuts of the owner's 17 recorded clips (audio_masters/*.wav) used by the game, built by tools/build_sfx.py into assets/audio/processed/. Times in seconds. The original OGG files stay untouched. Measured audit: docs/audio/SFX_AUDIT.md.

tyre_drift.event: loop: rear slip angle while drifting

tyre_regrip.event: a real drift ends and the tyres grip

turbo_spool.event: turbo cars: throttle stamped from closed

exhaust_single.event: single pop on lift-off at medium speed

exhaust_pops.event: pop burst once per afterfire window

barrier_scrape_heavy.event: loop: body sliding along a wall

not_used.tyre_rolling: Contains a low engine hum (60-200 Hz harmonics, f0 ~58 Hz), no tyre noise; replaced by the synth road-noise layer.
not_used.tyre_corner: Same engine hum with a rev sweep, no tyre squeal.
not_used.turbo_flutter: Low-frequency flutter overlapping turbo_bov on every lift; kept out to avoid stacking.
not_used.engine_limiter: 7 s of continuous high-rev engine audio; it fights the per-car engine synth, which already models the limiter.
